title: First Draft: Hamawy Wins! The Witness to the Genocide in Gaza Is on His Way to Congress

democracy protesters in Tiananmen Square, in Beijing. By nightfall the

tiananmen-foreshadowing-response-to-george-floyd-protests-2020-6) the Chinese
government for putting down the protests "with strength."_

rapid-fire news days we've seen in a while - and I cover **Donald Trump** for
a living. If that reads like a plea for help, well, what can I say?

In today's **' First Draft,' **an American doctor who treated patients in Gaza
just won his Democratic primary race. Plus, Trump gives one of his worst
henchmen a new role; the U.S.-Iran war is still not over; and the acting AG
says the president's $1.8 billion slush fund won't move forward - just don't
put that in writing or anything like that. _Seriously_.

In April 2024, **Zeteo** announced its formal launch with a [live event at the
Spy Museum](https://zeteo.com/p/exclusive-aoc-on-gaza-iran-and-the) in DC,
featuring **Mehdi** interviewing **Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez** on stage.
Sitting in the audience that night was a little-known doctor from New Jersey
who told Mehdi that he was on his way to volunteer in Gaza.

Last night, that doctor, [Adam Hamawy](https://hamawyfornj.com/), won the
Democratic primary in New Jersey's 12th congressional district, despite an
aggressive smear campaign by pro-Israel Dems, and is now on his way to
Congress, where he will presumably join Ocasio-Cortez's leftist 'Squad.'

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Hamawy easily defeated second-place finisher Brad Cohen, who
[decried](https://jewishinsider.com/2026/05/adam-hamawy-democratic-rivals-
josh-gottheimer-terror-ties/) **" his association"** with terrorists - a
reference to Hamawy's testimony at the trial of Islamist militant Omar Abdel-
Rahman in 1995. What his critics don't mention is that Hamawy was a first-
responder in New York on 9/11, treating victims of the terror attack on the
Twin Towers, then deployed to Iraq in 2004 and 2005 as a combat medic, and
later rose to the rank of lieutenant-colonel in the U.S. Army. Speaking [with
](https://zeteo.com/p/adam-hamawy-congress-gaza-doctor-new-jersey)**[Zeteo's
Prem Thakker](https://zeteo.com/p/adam-hamawy-congress-gaza-doctor-new-
jersey)** on the eve of the primary, Hamawy called the attacks on him **"
ridiculous"** and an effort to distract from his efforts to fight **" a
genocide that's happening right now, and real terrorism, and a terrorist
state."**
